name: inter-agent
description: Cross-host inter-agent messaging for Claude Code sessions: connect a skill-driven Monitor listener, send and broadcast messages, join channels, and coordinate with other AI coding sessions.

project_path.title: inter-agent project path
project_path.description: Optional local inter-agent-claude-code checkout. When set, the plugin uses <project_path>/.venv/bin/inter-agent-claude before the managed runtime or PATH.

secret.title: inter-agent shared secret
secret.description: Optional high-entropy shared secret passed to helpers as INTER_AGENT_SECRET for use across isolated filesystems.
